# Final source adoption decisions

These are source adaptation decisions for the target collection, not a publication,
installed-host result or final acceptance receipt. Implementation revision
`61871a2b9fa2843e4c68bfbddb3108101afa57ac` identifies the reviewed local implementation.
It is not an assertion that every upstream source was adopted at that revision.
The final generated source hashes bind separately in the provenance index and
the release acceptance audit.

The 89 target identities retain all 71 historical baseline identities and all
original source/adoption records. Historical unknown adoption revisions remain
unknown. The original HyperFrames and Unlazy source hashes are unchanged; their
derived adaptation hashes remain separate. `historical-binding.json` binds the
complete historical portion before this edit, and `decisions.json` lists each
target's disposition and evidence.

| Target scope | Source decision and evidence boundary |
| --- | --- |
| Core and specialists | Preserve all 20 dedicated public roots and four private core capabilities. Seven canonical instruction bodies unchanged from v3.8 are retained-baseline: Clarify, Roadmap, Spec, Code Build, Deploy Prompt, domain modeling and module decomposition. Other source clarification is adopted. Group A captures establish the named routing, authority, prototype, setup, triage and teaching cases; the debug fixture establishes one actual causal repair. Static contract/source review is narrower than an executed end-to-end example of every root. |
| Advanced | Adopt twelve separate QS roots and sixteen private capabilities, with original PS attribution. Review/evaluation and verification-lifecycle records support their scoped behaviors. Visual parity remains dedicated; its fixed image/state controls and refusal case are not a browser-parity result for a real product. |
| Frontend | Adopt four public outcomes and nine private capabilities, preserving all seven mapped contributors. Original nonmobile cases pass their independent reviews; the dialog supplement observes the same six artifacts while preserving original observer failures. The separate six native-portrait trials and the user's 2026-09-28 amendment qualify the candidate with explicitly reported image-font limitations. Original exact-size and strict brand failures remain failed. |
| Video | Adopt one explicit root and all 21 private modules. Exact source closure contains 912 original records and 911 retained files, with 186 relative imports after the caption adaptation. Measured Linux rendering, seek, audio and caption paths and the native three-frame inspection are bounded evidence. External provider availability, ASR/TTS, arbitrary footage and every theme are not certified. |
| Execution | Adopt one explicit root and the complete private Unlazy engine. Existing Linux Node16/24 and moved-install checks support the documented contract. Hooks remain opt-in. Status alone cannot detect all transitive artifact changes; use reverify. Windows execution and arbitrary detached-process containment remain unverified. |

Group B is **retained-baseline for every package**. The incomplete 45/222
comparison does not justify adopting compression or claiming better efficiency,
latency, cost or general quality. A source decision of `adopted` refers to the
local functional adaptation, never the rejected compression experiment.

The mobile exception is limited to the explicitly reported font mismatch in
`review-82f1387ba536341b`, whose applicable grades all meet the frozen floor. Its
strict result remains failed; the other two candidate trials passed strictly.
The baseline transparency and quality failures are not excused. No grades are
rewritten or pooled, and no exact numeric image-size guarantee is introduced.

Known reporting limitations remain visible: A7/E7 and the corrected video
observation omit required presentation fields. Their intended bounded behavior
passes do not certify complete adherence to the shared presentation contract.
Generic A5/E1 and original V3 failures are preserved, with later separate evidence
addressing specific gaps. These source decisions do not waive final metadata,
projected-runtime, native-discovery, version, release or actual-host gates.

`evidence-bindings.json` hashes the exact existing records used here. Test source
is labeled as source, not represented as a new successful execution. The prior
462-test receipt supports the source revision only; final target checks remain
the parent's responsibility.

Four passes completed: inventory historical and target records; assess evidence
against each package and the narrow amendment; challenge unsupported adoption,
compression and runtime claims; polish and verify bindings. Run
`node tests/fixtures/adoption-provenance-final/verify.mjs` after the parent refreshes
any completion-tail digests changed by final generation. The verifier reads only;
it never mutates provenance or upgrades a decision.
